name: Alerts Format - Olivero
description: Formatting enhancements for using the Alerts recipe with the Olivero theme.
project_description: Submodule of Alerts Format that adapts alert banners for the Olivero theme. Its hook_views_pre_render() attaches the 'alerts_format_olivero/olivero_display' library to the 'alerts' View, adding CSS that stretches alert banners full-width across the Olivero site header and a small JavaScript behavior (alerts-dismiss.js) that appends a close button to each banner and hides dismissed banners, remembering them per browser in localStorage. Depends on the alerts_format parent module; ships a block config that places the alerts Views block in the Olivero header region.
